oneOf.description: Import semantic boundary surfaces (wall/roof/ground/opening) and optional PV geometry from a RenoDAT-style STEP file onto a Building or BuildingPart.
Import volume geometry from a STEP file onto a Zone or ZonePart. All shells are collected into a single lod0MultiSurface or lod1-3Solid.
